Initial release of the text-to-comic skill, transforming user-provided text into comics, picture books, or infographics.

- Automatically analyzes user input to determine best visual form, style, and layout (comic, picture book, infographic, etc.).
- Offers structured, multi-step process: content type detection → visual format selection → style recommendation → storyboard and character setup.
- Enforces strict rules to maintain character consistency, scene continuity, clean visuals, and proper text handling.
- Supports user input for style customization and confirmation at key decision points.
- Generates individual comic panels and combines them into coherent, high-quality visual output.
